tinqiao-oss-engramory-root.description: Curated, file-based long-term memory for an AI agent. Use this skill (1) at the start of a task or when resuming unfinished work to recall via the memory index, (2) during a task to save durable user, feedback, project, or reference facts, (3) when a task finishes, to run the completion checkpoint — promote what is durable, retire what was only transient, and write nothing when nothing qualifies (an empty checkpoint still has to be decided) — and (4) before compacting, clearing context, or opening a fresh thread to sync the current goal, state, decisions, constraints, blockers, and next step.…
